name: – Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz – After § 34 – Am 12
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 34a. Stresses that the removal of tariffs on agricultural products must not expose European farmers and food producers to unfair competition from Mexican imports produced under lower environmental, animal welfare and food safety standards than those required in the EU; calls on the Commission to activate safeguard clauses swiftly and automatically where import surges cause or threaten to cause serious injury to sensitive EU agricultural sectors, in particular beef, pork, poultry and dairy;
